build.beforeDevCommand: bash -lc 'for p in ./scripts/dev-desktop-stack.sh ../scripts/dev-desktop-stack.sh ../../scripts/dev-desktop-stack.sh ../../../scripts/dev-desktop-stack.sh; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then exec bash "$p"; fi; done; echo "dev-desktop-stack.sh not found from $(pwd)" >&2; exit 1'
build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -lc 'for d in . ./. ../.. ../../..; do if [ -f "$d/pnpm-workspace.yaml" ]; then pnpm --dir "$d" --filter @x-file/shared build && pnpm --dir "$d" --filter @x-file/indexer build && pnpm --dir "$d" --filter @x-file/web build && exec pnpm --dir "$d" run prepare:bundled-server; fi; done; echo "pnpm workspace root not found from $(pwd)" >&2; exit 1'

bundle.longDescription: X-File 是从 CodingNS 拆出的本机文档库应用。签名和自动更新配置已预留，发布前必须替换真实 secrets 并在实机 runner 验证。
